newsitem.title: USA: Seagram says Grand Met deal anticompetitive.
newsitem.headline: Seagram says Grand Met deal anticompetitive.

text.p: Seagram Co Ltd said Monday that a proposed union between Grand Metropolitan Plc and Guinness Plc is an anticompetitive transaction that likely would require large divestitures before being approved by regulators.

"The deal, in our view, poses serious antitrust problems in the U.S. and Europe and possibly elsewhere," said Robert Matschullat, vice chairman and chief financial officer of the beverage company that makes brands such as Chivas Regal Scotch Whisky.
Matschullat said the company has not determined whether it will formally seek to block the proposed transaction.
"I don't know if they think the regulators are asleep at the switch here, but we don't," he said.
Officials of the two companies earlier said they were confident the proposed transaction would clear regulatory hurdles.
